name: bZx iToken empty-pool donation rounding
summary: The attacker emptied iYFI, minted 5 wei of shares, and donated the flash-borrowed YFI directly to the pool. LoanTokenLogic derived an enormous collateral value from the resulting assets-per-share ratio, while integer rounding still let the attacker recover the 5 wei of iYFI after borrowing assets from other iToken pools. The same sequence was repeated in a second transaction.

loss.notes: This is an exact realised-proceeds net measurement for the heterogeneous borrowed-token basket. After the YFI flash swaps and all liquidations, the attack contract forwarded 41.985181310472257483 ETH in the anchor and 57.764524113108736517 ETH in the follow-up transaction to the attacker EOA, totalling 99.749705423580994 ETH. At the nearest pre-anchor DefiLlama price of 2,091.30 USD, that is 208,606.5589523349327522 USD. Gas is not deducted and no later recovery is netted.

ageReset.description: The iYFI proxy's owner-only setTarget call changed target_ in slot 20 from 0x528d205b9521a5e5193b3da9be940c6a18d32a4d to the LoanTokenLogicStandard implementation exploited 339.65 days later.

sources.note: Both exploit receipts succeed at blocks 18695729:0 and 18695746:0. Their traces show the attacker repeatedly burning the existing 5 wei of iYFI, minting 5 wei into the empty pool, donating the YFI flash-swap balance directly to iYFI, borrowing against those shares and withdrawing all 5 wei of collateral. The anchor trace reaches iYFI 0x7f3fe9d492a9a60aebb06d82cba23c6f32cad10b through mint, burn and transferFrom, and every delegated frame uses LoanTokenLogicStandard 0x624f7f89414011b276c60ea2337bfba936d1cbbe. The verified LoanToken proxy source stores target_ in slot 20 and exposes owner-only setTarget; the verified logic and the pinned reproduction establish the assets-per-share inflation and rounding path. The campaign's borrowed-token basket was liquidated before the attack contract forwarded exactly 41.985181310472257483 ETH and 57.764524113108736517 ETH to the attacker EOA. The 99.749705423580994 ETH sum, priced at 2,091.30 USD, is 208,606.5589523349327522 USD. The iYFI proxy was internally CREATE-deployed by 0x8cc1cfdc1c60c19a1d7c0fa3c042a4916aa79a51 in source-6 at block 10785097:26. Its target_ history contains eight post-deployment logic changes; source-5 is the last, at block 16275583:93, where the trace calls setTarget(0x624f7f89414011b276c60ea2337bfba936d1cbbe) and the transaction state diff changes slot 20 from 0x528d205b9521a5e5193b3da9be940c6a18d32a4d to that implementation. The slot remains 0x624f7f89414011b276c60ea2337bfba936d1cbbe immediately before exploitation, and the artifact runtime hashes to 0xba0ef85dda1f920512e075fba1b8eddc45c180c1ec65ff6f170973347ce9750a at activation and pre-exploit. The last reset is therefore 29,345,952 seconds before the anchor, not the proxy's 1,185-day deployment age.

limitations: The exact figure is the campaign's realised ETH proceeds rather than a gross mark of every heterogeneous token and LP token borrowed from the iToken pools.
